why: Image 2 reads as a real room photographed at night: the shallow depth of field, the dark stone wall and the window onto a lit street place the bowl in a specific location, and the warm side light on the hammered bronze and the pale wood shelf is believable. Image 1 looks staged and rendered: one hard spotlight on a bowl of oversaturated, glowing chips, a cartoonish wood grain and an anonymous black void, though in image 2 the overhanging bowl and the black tab poking out from under it on the shelf look slightly off.
